validators.name: required
validators.description: No.JS: Field must not be empty (whitespace-only counts as empty).

validators.name: email
validators.description: No.JS: Field must be a valid email address (user@domain.tld). An empty value passes.

validators.name: url
validators.description: No.JS: Field must parse with new URL(). Fails an empty value unless validate-empty="skip".

validators.name: min
validators.description: No.JS: Minimum numeric value (not a length). An empty value counts as 0 unless validate-empty="skip".

validators.name: max
validators.description: No.JS: Maximum numeric value (not a length). An empty value counts as 0 unless validate-empty="skip".

validators.name: custom
validators.description: No.JS: Runs the validator registered with NoJS.validator(name, fn); it receives (value, formValues), no rule arguments.
